title: The benefits of good posture - Murat Dalkilinç
speaker: TED-Ed
zh: 【TED-Ed】良好姿勢的好處 - Murat Dalkilinç（精選雙語跟讀教材）

cues.text: Has anyone ever told you, "Stand up straight!" or scolded you for slouching at a family dinner?
cues.en: Has anyone ever told you, "Stand up straight!" or scolded you for slouching at a family dinner?
cues.zh: 有沒有人曾經告訴過你：“站直！” 或是和家人晚餐時 因為彎腰駝背而被訓斥？

cues.text: Comments like that might be annoying, but they're not wrong.
cues.en: Comments like that might be annoying, but they're not wrong.
cues.zh: 或是和家人晚餐時 因為彎腰駝背而被訓斥？ 雖說 “忠言逆耳”， 但他們並沒有錯

cues.text: Your posture, the way you hold your body when you're sitting or standing,
cues.en: Your posture, the way you hold your body when you're sitting or standing,
cues.zh: 雖說 “忠言逆耳”， 但他們並沒有錯 當你或坐或站時， 姿勢（維持身體的方式）

cues.text: is the foundation for every movement your body makes, and can determine how well your body adapts to the stresses on it.
cues.en: is the foundation for every movement your body makes, and can determine how well your body adapts to the stresses on it.
cues.zh: 當你或坐或站時， 姿勢（維持身體的方式） 是每個動作的基礎 且能決定你如何適應加諸身體的壓力

cues.text: These stresses can be things like carrying weight, or sitting in an awkward position.
cues.en: These stresses can be things like carrying weight, or sitting in an awkward position.
cues.zh: 這些壓力可能是搬運重物 或者彆扭的坐姿 而每天承受最大的壓力就是：重力

cues.text: And the big one we all experience all day every day: gravity.
cues.en: And the big one we all experience all day every day: gravity.
cues.zh: 而每天承受最大的壓力就是：重力 如果你的姿勢不良

cues.text: If your posture isn't optimal, your muscles have to work harder to keep you upright and balanced.
cues.en: If your posture isn't optimal, your muscles have to work harder to keep you upright and balanced.
cues.zh: 而每天承受最大的壓力就是：重力 如果你的姿勢不良 肌肉就需要更用力 來維持直立與平衡

cues.text: Some muscles will become tight and inflexbile.
cues.en: Some muscles will become tight and inflexbile.
cues.zh: 有些肌肉會變得緊繃而僵硬 有些則會受到抑制而鬆弛

cues.text: Others will be inhibited.
cues.en: Others will be inhibited.
cues.zh: 有些肌肉會變得緊繃而僵硬 有些則會受到抑制而鬆弛

cues.text: Over time, these dysfunctional adaptations impair your body's ability to deal with the forces on it.
cues.en: Over time, these dysfunctional adaptations impair your body's ability to deal with the forces on it.
cues.zh: 有些則會受到抑制而鬆弛 時間一久，這些不正常的協調動作 將會損害你身體對抗外力的能力

cues.text: Poor posture inflicts extra wear and tear on your joints and ligaments,
cues.en: Poor posture inflicts extra wear and tear on your joints and ligaments,
cues.zh: 將會損害你身體對抗外力的能力 不良姿勢會對關節 和韌帶造成更多磨損 增加意外的可能

cues.text: increases the likelihood of accidents, and makes some organs, like your lungs, less efficient.
cues.en: increases the likelihood of accidents, and makes some organs, like your lungs, less efficient.
cues.zh: 增加意外的可能 並且降低某些器官的效能，例如肺

cues.text: Researchers have linked poor posture to scoliosis, tension headaches,
cues.en: Researchers have linked poor posture to scoliosis, tension headaches,
cues.zh: 並且降低某些器官的效能，例如肺 研究者認為脊椎側凸、 緊張性頭痛 以及背痛都和姿勢不良有關

cues.text: and back pain, though it isn't the exclusive cause of any of them.
cues.en: and back pain, though it isn't the exclusive cause of any of them.
cues.zh: 以及背痛都和姿勢不良有關 雖然它並不是唯一的原因

cues.text: Posture can even influence your emotional state and your sensitivity to pain.
cues.en: Posture can even influence your emotional state and your sensitivity to pain.
cues.zh: 姿勢甚至可以影響情緒 和對疼痛的敏感度 所以保持良好的姿勢 並不是沒有道理的

cues.text: So there are a lot of reasons to aim for good posture.
cues.en: So there are a lot of reasons to aim for good posture.
cues.zh: 所以保持良好的姿勢 並不是沒有道理的

cues.text: But it's getting harder these days.
cues.en: But it's getting harder these days.
cues.zh: 所以保持良好的姿勢 並不是沒有道理的 但現在保持良好的姿勢越來越難了

cues.text: Sitting in an awkward position for a long time can promote poor posture,
cues.en: Sitting in an awkward position for a long time can promote poor posture,
cues.zh: 但現在保持良好的姿勢越來越難了 長時間用彆扭的坐姿會促成姿勢不良 使用電腦和其他行動裝置亦同

cues.text: and so can using computers or mobile devices, which encourage you to look downward.
cues.en: and so can using computers or mobile devices, which encourage you to look downward.
cues.zh: 使用電腦和其他行動裝置亦同 因為它們讓你變成低頭族 許多研究顯示， 一般人的姿勢變得越來越糟糕了

cues.text: Many studies suggest that, on average, posture is getting worse.
cues.en: Many studies suggest that, on average, posture is getting worse.
cues.zh: 許多研究顯示， 一般人的姿勢變得越來越糟糕了

cues.text: So what does good posture look like?
cues.en: So what does good posture look like?
cues.zh: 許多研究顯示， 一般人的姿勢變得越來越糟糕了 好姿勢看起來 是怎麼樣的呢？

cues.text: When you look at the spine from the front or the back, all 33 vertebrae should appear stacked in a straight line.
cues.en: When you look at the spine from the front or the back, all 33 vertebrae should appear stacked in a straight line.
cues.zh: 當從正面或背面來看脊椎時 33個脊椎骨看起來應該在一條直線上 從側面看，脊椎應當有三個彎

cues.text: From the side, the spine should have three curves: one at your neck, one at your shoulders, and one at the small of your back.
cues.en: From the side, the spine should have three curves: one at your neck, one at your shoulders, and one at the small of your back.
cues.zh: 從側面看，脊椎應當有三個彎 分別在脖子、肩膀以及腰背部

cues.text: You aren't born with this s-shaped spine.
cues.en: You aren't born with this s-shaped spine.
cues.zh: 人並不是天生就有這個 S 曲線的

cues.text: Babies' spines just have one curve like a "c." The other curves usually develop by 12-18 months
cues.en: Babies' spines just have one curve like a "c." The other curves usually develop by 12-18 months
cues.zh: 人並不是天生就有這個 S 曲線的 嬰兒的脊椎只有一個彎曲， 就像字母 C 其他的彎曲將會在 12-18 個月內

cues.text: as the muscles strengthen.
cues.en: as the muscles strengthen.
cues.zh: 隨著肌力的強化而形成 這些彎曲幫助我們直立 並幫我們分擔一些

cues.text: These curves help us stay upright and absorb some of the stress from activities like walking and jumping.
cues.en: These curves help us stay upright and absorb some of the stress from activities like walking and jumping.
cues.zh: 這些彎曲幫助我們直立 並幫我們分擔一些 來自於走路或跳躍的壓力 如果排列妥當

cues.text: If they are aligned properly, when you're standing up, you should be able to draw a straight line
cues.en: If they are aligned properly, when you're standing up, you should be able to draw a straight line
cues.zh: 如果排列妥當 當你直立時 從側面應當能畫一條直線

cues.text: from a point just in front of your shoulders, to behind your hip,
cues.en: from a point just in front of your shoulders, to behind your hip,
cues.zh: 從側面應當能畫一條直線 從肩膀前方開始 到臀部的後方

cues.text: to the front of your knee, to a few inches in front of your ankle.
cues.en: to the front of your knee, to a few inches in front of your ankle.
cues.zh: 到臀部的後方 到膝蓋前方 再到達腳踝前幾英吋的地方

cues.text: This keeps your center of gravity directly over your base of support,
cues.en: This keeps your center of gravity directly over your base of support,
cues.zh: 再到達腳踝前幾英吋的地方 這使得你的重心在支撐面的正上方

cues.text: which allows you to move efficiently with the least amount of fatigue and muscle strain.
cues.en: which allows you to move efficiently with the least amount of fatigue and muscle strain.
cues.zh: 讓你能有效率地移動 減少疲勞和肌肉緊張 坐著時，脖子應當豎直

cues.text: If you're sitting, your neck should be vertical, not tilted forward.
cues.en: If you're sitting, your neck should be vertical, not tilted forward.
cues.zh: 坐著時，脖子應當豎直 而不是前傾 肩膀應當放鬆，雙臂靠近軀幹

cues.text: Your shoulders should be relaxed with your arms close to your trunk.
cues.en: Your shoulders should be relaxed with your arms close to your trunk.
cues.zh: 而不是前傾 肩膀應當放鬆，雙臂靠近軀幹

cues.text: Your knees should be at a right angle with your feet flat on the floor.
cues.en: Your knees should be at a right angle with your feet flat on the floor.
cues.zh: 肩膀應當放鬆，雙臂靠近軀幹 膝蓋應該呈垂直彎曲， 腳掌平放在地面上

cues.text: But what if your posture isn't that great?
cues.en: But what if your posture isn't that great?
cues.zh: 膝蓋應該呈垂直彎曲， 腳掌平放在地面上 但如果你的姿勢並不是那樣好 嘗試重新設定所處的環境

cues.text: Try redesigning your environment.
cues.en: Try redesigning your environment.
cues.zh: 嘗試重新設定所處的環境 調整電腦螢幕， 使其與你的視線等高或略低

cues.text: Adjust your screen so it's at or slightly below eyelevel.
cues.en: Adjust your screen so it's at or slightly below eyelevel.
cues.zh: 調整電腦螢幕， 使其與你的視線等高或略低 確保你身體所有的部分

cues.text: Make sure all parts of your body, like your elbows and wrists, are supported,
cues.en: Make sure all parts of your body, like your elbows and wrists, are supported,
cues.zh: 調整電腦螢幕， 使其與你的視線等高或略低 確保你身體所有的部分 像肘部和手腕都有支撐

cues.text: using ergonomic aids if you need to.
cues.en: using ergonomic aids if you need to.
cues.zh: 像肘部和手腕都有支撐 必要時，使用人體工學的輔助裝置

cues.text: Try sleeping on your side with your neck supported and with a pillow between your legs.
cues.en: Try sleeping on your side with your neck supported and with a pillow between your legs.
cues.zh: 必要時，使用人體工學的輔助裝置 側睡時，試著讓脖子得到支撐 在雙腿之間夾一個枕頭

cues.text: Wear shoes with low heels and good arch support, and use a headset for phone calls.
cues.en: Wear shoes with low heels and good arch support, and use a headset for phone calls.
cues.zh: 在雙腿之間夾一個枕頭 穿低跟並保護足弓的鞋 並使用耳麥來接電話

cues.text: It's also not enough to just have good posture.
cues.en: It's also not enough to just have good posture.
cues.zh: 並使用耳麥來接電話 單單有好的姿勢是不夠的

cues.text: Keeping your muscles and joints moving is extremely important.
cues.en: Keeping your muscles and joints moving is extremely important.
cues.zh: 單單有好的姿勢是不夠的 保持肌肉和關節的運動很重要 事實上，長時間用好的姿勢保持靜止

cues.text: In fact, being stationary for long periods with good posture
cues.en: In fact, being stationary for long periods with good posture
cues.zh: 事實上，長時間用好的姿勢保持靜止

cues.text: can be worse than regular movement with bad posture.
cues.en: can be worse than regular movement with bad posture.
cues.zh: 可能比經常變換 不良的姿勢更加糟糕

cues.text: When you do move, move smartly.
cues.en: When you do move, move smartly.
cues.zh: 可能比經常變換 不良的姿勢更加糟糕 要動就要動得聰明一點

cues.text: Keep anything you're carrying close to your body.
cues.en: Keep anything you're carrying close to your body.
cues.zh: 要動就要動得聰明一點 搬運任何東西都要靠近身體

cues.text: Backpacks should be in contact with your back carried symetrically.
cues.en: Backpacks should be in contact with your back carried symetrically.
cues.zh: 揹包應當對稱且緊貼後背

cues.text: If you sit a lot, get up and move around on occassion,
cues.en: If you sit a lot, get up and move around on occassion,
cues.zh: 揹包應當對稱且緊貼後背 如果你常需要坐著，偶爾要起來走走

cues.text: and be sure to exercise.
cues.en: and be sure to exercise.
cues.zh: 如果你常需要坐著，偶爾要起來走走 還有就是一定要運動 經常使用肌肉會讓它們保持強健， 足以有效地支撐你的身體

cues.text: Using your muscles will keep them strong enough to support you effectively,
cues.en: Using your muscles will keep them strong enough to support you effectively,
cues.zh: 經常使用肌肉會讓它們保持強健， 足以有效地支撐你的身體

cues.text: on top of all the other benefits to your joints, bones, brain and heart.
cues.en: on top of all the other benefits to your joints, bones, brain and heart.
cues.zh: 經常使用肌肉會讓它們保持強健， 足以有效地支撐你的身體 更重要的是這對關節、骨頭、 大腦以及心臟都有益處

cues.text: And if you're really worried, check with a physical therapist, because yes, you really should stand up straight.
cues.en: And if you're really worried, check with a physical therapist, because yes, you really should stand up straight.
cues.zh: 如果你實在很擔心，去找理療師諮詢 因為，是的 你真的應當站直
